items.t: The 4 cities of Kawalerielki have successfully docked together, raising the curtain on the Kazimierz Major

blocks.p: Last night, the Knights Association announced the twelve division spokespeople for this season. They will represent the sponsors, the Knights Association and the National Council to ensure that the Major proceeds without incident. During the appointment ceremony, the twelve spokespeople performed their first duty in collectively announcing the passing of a bill by the National Council back in May: All convicted knights with outstanding contributions shall be granted a commuted sentence.

To allow each and every knight to achieve glory and hone their skills has long been the unchanging motto of the Kazimierz Major. We look forward to seeing the valiant knights during the preliminaries for each division.

items.t: The Radiant Knight appears once more? Will the debuting knight of the Nearl family restore honor to the nobility?

blocks.p: The preliminaries of the Kazimierz Major have been ongoing for several months now. Besides the seven Knightclubs directly invited to join the Major and the four Knight Orders, the remaining knights have been competing against one another to accumulate points in the preliminaries.
However, an unexpected contestant appeared yesterday in the West Division's Roar Arena——Maria Nearl. This is a big deal for any knightwatcher.

Six years ago, the Radiant Knight who shot to fame after winning the championship was expelled when it was discovered she had concealed her infection, causing the old and once prestigious family to fall into the awkward situation of not having a presiding Knight Primus. Back then, Młynar Nearl who was pushed to the forefront refused the Knights Association's invitation, and the Nearl family was on the brink of losing their noble status.

In the end, the National Council declared that should the Nearl family not present a new Knight Primus with a legitimate title within five years, they would be stripped of their nobility. Maria Nearl's performance in the current season will determine the fate of the Nearl family.
We will watch this young knight closely.

items.t: More than a hundred knights join the banquet held by the Northwood Order!

blocks.p: The name 'Northwood' should not be unfamiliar to any knight who follows the Kazimierz Major. As one of the Knight Orders of Kazimierz and still in its prime, there are many veteran Knightclubs under its banner such as the Blade Helmet Knightclub and the Spikeshield Knightclub. With no other Knightclubs promoted to Knight Orders this year, Northwood has managed to maintain their hold on the Central Division, but the situation remains dismal as the Knight Orders of the other Divisions continue to eye them eagerly.

The stated objective of the banquet is to celebrate the several new knight contestants, but it is easy to ascertain that more than half the invited knights are unaffiliated and even untitled independent knights. Obviously, to continue remaining an 'Order' and avoid falling to the status of a 'Club', Northwood has decided to expand during the current season to avoid a poor showing. We watch with bated breath to see how many are attracted by the promised cake.

items.t: Qualitative Report on the Suborning of Infected: Kindness does not imply indulgence

blocks.p: This year is the third since the inception of the Infected Participation System. We are extremely happy to announce that this humanitarian initiative has achieved significant results, with Infected-related incidents dropping substantially in many areas. The comportment of the Infected fighting for their lives has won them unique respect as well as tangible wealth they require for survival.

However, as the number of Infected participants increases year-on-year, problems have inevitably cropped up. Besides the challenge of getting proper treatment to Infected knights, some Infected who have attained great wealth through competitions and their fighting skills have begun to buy over their Infected kin and set up private organizations unrecognized by the Knights Association. These organizations are heavily suspected to be involved in illegal fundraising and holding armed rallies with the goal of disrupting social stability and taking revenge against non-Infected.

Currently, the Knights Association has filed a legal complaint to the National Council requesting to remedy the problem of Infected knights taking in large numbers of illegal Infected. Kazimierz will never allow the 'Great Kawalerielki Separation' incident to happen ever again.
TOP5
Mist Knight VS Broken Wrist Knight

Comment: A relatively straightforward test of weapon skills, with both knights having mastered countless weapon techniques. This spectacular battle is in fact a showcase of the infinite refinement of traditional techniques!
TOP4
Independent knight Fioren VS Independent knight Austin

Comment: Both are untitled knights, but one hails from an old and established knight family, whereas the other is from a true grassroots background. The viewers' hopes and dreams wallpaper this knightly battle! You won't want to miss this!
TOP3
Independent knight Maria Nearl VS Plastic Knight

Comment: As the sister of the Radiant Knight, Maria has gained widespread popularity due to her family name alone. With her ingenious usage of Originium Arts to target the enemy's weak spots, a technique that differs greatly from the Radiant Knight's combat style, this is surely worth a watch!
TOP2
Independent knight Justyna Valentine VS Feather Knight

Comment: As a battle between two bowmen, this will be a test of speed and skill. This huge arena seems suddenly small before the life-and-death struggle of these two master sharpshooters. Come and feel the tension!
TOP1
Candle Knight VS Stream Knight

Comment: A duel between powerful knights that should not have appeared in the preliminaries. The reason the Candle Knight is participating in this battle despite a special invitation to the Major is currently a topic of much speculation, with many rumors abound. The fusion and clashing of Leithanian Arts and traditional knight techniques will surely bring about a battle for the ages!
Videos for the above matches will be on sale at every arena. They will also be rebroadcast on the 'Knight's Blade' channel tomorrow night at 8.

items.t: '10 Years in the making' Mid-Tournament Special Report

blocks.p: After approval by the Knights Association and a unanimous vote from the National Council, the Tyrell Knightclub which has long been sponsored by the Ellen Select Technology Co. and a fierce contender within the Top 100 Knightclubs has finally been promoted to a Knight Order. Currently, there are only two Knightclubs under the banner of the Tyrell Knight Order: The Rachel Knightclub composed of the original members and renamed after the leader's surname, and the Warwhip Knightclub responsible for training young reserve knights. Though they are lacking in numbers, the addition of the former second runner-up Frost Skull Knight as an instructor in the Warwhip Knightclub has made waves.

At the same time, with the approval of the Knights Association, the first superstar of the current season has emerged even before the preliminaries have ended, receiving a knight's title after yesterday evening's match. With her outstanding ability, incredibly high number of votes and rapidly rising point ranking, independent knight Justyna managed to attract the attention of many companies, earning her the title of 'Fartooth' early this morning.

No matter if it's 'Fartooth' Justyna or Tyrell Knight Order, all of this signifies the outstanding development of the Kazimierz competition industry. We look forward to seeing what new trends will come from this season of the Kazimierz Major.
Specially chosen for you by Big Data

items.t: Nearl's Secret Base? Secret Bar Exposed! You Won't Believe Which Knights Drink Here!

blocks.p: At the end of Golden Feather Street, there is an unassuming bar with a strange name——Scary Martin. Such bars can be found all over Kazimierz, but this one is unique for one particular reason most people are unaware of. This bar's regular clientele are almost all retired knights.

That isn't what's important, though. The real story is the Radiant Knight's sister Maria Nearl and the Whislash Knight Zofia, who are often in the area after the bar closes. Most bars don't close so early, and it's a bit of a stretch to say that it's because of bad business. But Maria and Whislash have been frequently seen near the bar. I'm sure everyone is familiar with Maria, and as an independent knight her relationship with Whislash was once a hot topic. Even after Maria joined the Major representing the Nearl family, Młynar Nearl, who was once pushed for the same position kept quiet. According to his coworkers, he has paid no attention to it and is still working an ordinary job, as if he has nothing to do with it.

Perhaps the secret behind the Nearl family lies within this bar. Your correspondent has no other information to report for now, but readers who wish to witness the Nearls' grace may want to try their luck.

items.t: General Chamber of Commerce approves bill from Adeptus Sprawiedliwi Kazimierz raising contribution ratio

blocks.p: On the night of 18th, the Kazimierz General Chamber of Commerce unanimously voted to pass an amendment to the Corporate Contribution Act proposed by the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi Kazimierz. Starting next year, the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi Kazimierz will raise the corporate contribution ratio across the board in some territories. The additional funds raised will be put towards the military budget for several dozen military Knightclubs including the Silverlance Pegasus Knightclub. This move can be seen as a countermeasure against Ursus's increasing military activities.

At the same time, some managing directors from the General Chamber of Commerce raised a proposal for large corporations to collectively form a 'Security Force', to keep the peace in the Kazimierz Major and the various city-states. This proposal was rejected by the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi Kazimierz.

items.t: Rebellion and ignorance of the new generation——Seven rising stars reject all invitations from Knightclubs

blocks.p: Yesterday afternoon, the Fartooth Knight rejected invitations from multiple corporations for the third time, and publicly expressed her intention to establish an 'Independent Knightclub.' Simultaneously, the popular independent knight Maria Nearl rejected invitations from corporations such as the Słoma Food Company. The rising Infected Knightclub 'Pinus Sylvestris' also stated that they will not be entering into a partnership with any corporation. Things being what they are, one can't help but wonder: With the rapid development of knight sports, does this pursuit of 'freedom' and these attempts to restore the 'glory of knights' in peacetime highlight the ignorance and naivety of this new generation of young knights?

The relationship between Knightclub and sponsor is symbiotic, sharing in both the glory and failures. Ever since the implementation of the First Decree centuries ago, knights have enjoyed the respect of the populace. With the rapid development of Kazimierz, knights must also find a proper path forward in the new era. As for these disruptors among the young knights, perhaps spokesperson McKee describes them best: 'a heartbreaking misunderstanding.'

items.t: Midday Special News: 'Plastic' Szewczyk admitted to the Grand Knight's Territory's Third Hospital.

blocks.p: This morning, the vanguard of the Roar Knightclub, popular knight 'Plastic' Szewczyk held a birthday ceremony for his son at his private mansion. During the ceremony, Mr. Szewczyk felt unwell, and retired early to rest in his room. Later, a servant discovered Mr. Szewczyk collapsed in the corridor.

After the incident, Mr. Szewczyk's family declined all reporters and guests out of concern for 'the children.' When questioned, the person in charge at the Third Hospital stated 'Mr. Szewczyk is indeed accepting treatment here.' As for specifics, they cited only 'complications from an old wound.' Mr. Szewcyzk's fans have held well-wishing events to pray for the recovery of this well-known knight.

items.t: Fartooth Knight involved in fan violence? Whereabouts of the Fartooth Knight still unknown

blocks.p: What's the story behind the Fartooth Knight's involvement in fan violence? According to sources, the Fartooth Knight was heading to a workshop to retrieve repaired equipment on the night of the 7th. On the way, she met the overzealous fan of a certain Knightclub and the two got into a verbal argument, which soon devolved into a fistfight. As an officially titled knight, it is clear that 'Fartooth' Justyna made an error in judgement. When police officers arrived at the scene, there were several citizens who had been violently assaulted by the Fartooth Knight. They claimed that the Fartooth Knight had also suffered serious injuries, but she herself was nowhere to be seen.
The National Council has announced that they will investigate this incident seriously. Regardless of the guilt of the matter, this is not a reason for the Fartooth Knight to simply disappear.
Specially chosen for you by Big Data

Forty minutes ago, the exiled Margaret Nearl (henceforth referred to as the Radiant Knight) suddenly appeared in the Fireblade Arena, interrupting the ongoing contest in full view of millions of viewers. What is going on?

According to sources, there were multiple issues during the special 2V2 battle being held in the Fireblade Arena. Firstly, the Fartooth Knight was unable to participate due to the recent incident and Maria Nearl was forced to fight alone against the Snowyheel Knightclub. As for the Snowyheel Knightclub, they had temporarily accepted the Corrupted Knight and Withered Knight right before the match and decided then to send the both of them into battle. As the battle got into full swing, the Radiant Knight suddenly rushed into the arena, rescuing her nearly defeated sister and turning the tides.

The exiled are forbidden from entering any Kazimierz city. Though Infected are now allowed to participate, and the crowd's enthusiasm for the Radiant Knight remains as clear as ever. How will the National Council and the Knights Association respond? Are we witnessing the continuation of the legend? Can the Radiant Knight's 'lucky miracles' truly defeat her mighty opponents?

Will the Radiant Knight bring about new miracles, or will this blatant disregard for the Knights Association invite swift retaliation? As countless readers wait with bated breath, we strive to bring you the latest developments!
Specially chosen for you by Big Data

items.t: Knights Association and National Council seeking public opinion

blocks.p: This afternoon, the Radiant Knight returned to Kawalerielki and intervened in the battle between Maria and the Snowyheel Knightclub, causing a great uproar across the media and our viewers. After extensive discussions between the Knights Association and the spokesperson representative, it was agreed that the Radiant Knight's intervention in the battle was a clear violation of the rules, but due to the multiple violations from the two knights of the Snowyheel Knightclub as well, the match is invalid.

At the same time, the Knights Association raised a complaint to the National Council. The National Council will soon hold an emergency meeting to decide the status of the Radiant Knight's knighthood. If the Radiant Knight is acknowledged, the lack of a Knight Primus will no longer plague the Nearl family.

Currently, it appears that the audience and guests generally wish for the return of the Radiant Knight. This afternoon alone, petitions have circulated at several arenas. There is also overwhelming support for the Radiant Knight coming from various social media platforms. The Knights Association and National Council are expected to give their answer very soon.

items.t: Live: Several Managing Directors of the General Chamber of Commerce protest against the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi Kazimierz

blocks.p: Today, the Mieszko Group, Rose Paper Union and other companies raised a formal complaint against the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi Kazimierz. The representative for the collective claimed that the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi Kazimierz ordered the mobilization of some warrior-knights on its own discretion, without going through the legal process with the National Council. On the other hand, the Grand Knight's staff in the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi Kazimierz believes that the mobilization of the warrior-knights is a legitimate function accorded to the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi Kazimierz in times of emergency, and that the move was well within their rights.

The General Chamber of Commerce continued to demand the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi Kazimierz give a reasonable answer, while the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi Kazimierz insisted that as the highest judicial organ of Kazimierz, the National Council is not beholden to the General Chamber of Commerce, no matter what issues arise between the National Council and the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi Kazimierz.

Later on, the representative from the Mieszko Group accused the Knights Association of mishandling the Radiant Knight incident, and demanded alterations to the spokesperson system and some duties of the Knights Association. This move displeased some of the knightly nobility, though the General Chamber of Commerce indicated that revoking the amendment to the Corporate Contribution Act remains a distinct possibility. The meeting is currently still in session.
Dear Ms. Amiya:

I am pleased to inform you that the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi Kazimierz and Knights Association agreed yesterday to pass the 'Terms of Cooperation for Treatment of Infected Contestants & Medical Environment Rectification' bill proposed by your company. The electronic contract is attached to this email, and a contact will be visiting your office soon.

As a representative of the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi Kazimierz, I hereby send my regards to Miss Amiya and the members of the Medical Department in your company. The other medical and pharmaceutical companies involved in this project are extremely happy to receive your help, as we are all warmed by the virtue of assisting those in need.
At the same time, please allow me to extend my personal thanks to Miss Amiya, Miss Kal'tsit and the 'Doctor.'

Thank you for accepting and sheltering the Radiant Knight during her unjust exile. I guarantee, upon my honor as the Grand Knight of the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi Kazimierz, that Nearl will be treated fairly.
May Glory Live On.
Adeptus Sprawiedliwi Kazimierz
